name: m4-genbcode-alloc-ab
description: Timing and alloc/op A/B of GenBCode allocation fixes (branch `claude/genbcode-alloc-4bb6db`) against their base, the `scala2-perf-integration` tip `00e3bbafb8`: per-symbol `MethodBType` cache with memoised descriptor, unbuffered `VirtualFileWriter`, `VirtualFile` adopting an exactly-sized buffer, allocation-free `ClassBType.isSubtypeOf` recursion. Baseline profile: `m4-int00e3bb-prof` (BType.toString 46.9 MB/op, VirtualFile write path 123 MB/op on scala).

Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap. Builds alternate fork by fork over 3 rounds (a no-regression check: the expected time effect, ~0.1-0.3%, is below fork noise). scala: single-shot 4+4 ops; scalap: 20+20 x 2 s.
